ui_bugs.issue: checkout-email (and checkout-name/phone) are NOT prefilled from the logged-in user because the useState initializer runs before AuthContext /api/auth/me resolves. Field is empty on first render and never syncs. Fix: use a useEffect that updates form.email/full_name/phone when `user` transitions from null→object.

StatusTracker component works on both OrderSuccess and Account order-history. set-sender field wired via /api/settings. Only real finding: Checkout prefill race — form initialised before AuthContext /me resolves.
rca of the issue: Checkout.jsx line 22-24 initializes useState with user?.email at first render. AuthContext fetches /api/auth/me asynchronously in a useEffect; on first render user is null, so form.email = ''. When user becomes non-null the form state is NOT re-initialized (useState initializer runs once). Fix: add `useEffect(() => { if (user) setForm(f => ({...f, full_name: f.full_name || `${user.first_name} ${user.last_name}`, phone: f.phone || user.phone || '', email: f.email || user.email || ''})); }, [user]);`
